title: Rawy Baranco, Mach4Food: “The impact of equipment deserves greater attention”
summary: Rawy José Baranco is Manager of Sales and Co-Founder at Mach4Food, a family-owned company based in the Netherlands specialising in the international trade of used and refurbished machinery for the metal packaging industry..
